selection.pool: only unique feature sets with all three technically accepted development results from family_matrix, single_deletions, J1/J2; P has zero increment and is ineligible
selection.sort: exact Dbar descending; group within epsilon of fixed highest remaining Dbar anchor; within group exact worst annual Delta descending, subgroup within epsilon of fixed highest remaining worst-Delta anchor; within subgroup new-column-count ascending then candidate ID lexicographic; then next subgroup and next Dbar group; never adjacent chaining or approximate comparator
selection.alias_ID: first registered ID for identical feature tuple: family matrix order, then single deletion order, then J1/J2; preserve all aliases
selection.small_increment: 0<Dbar<=0.003: 小幅探索性增量; not automatic rejection or statistical equivalence
selection.seal_before_2024: freeze main/backup order and all risk evidence before new candidate 2024 results; no reranking/reselection from 2024

algorithm.J1: P+canonical union of families g with mean_y[S(P+g,y)-S(P,y)]>epsilon
algorithm.J2: F minus all new f with mean_y[E(f,y)]>epsilon; E(f,y)=S(F-f,y)-S(F,y)
algorithm.dedup: canonical ordered feature tuple; empty -> P; identical J1/J2 or accepted existing input/year/data/params must reuse; aliases retain lineage; never pad budget
algorithm.forbidden: no backfill, greedy iteration, third joint combination or all-subsets search; retain every P column
